subject: Discovery recap — schedule a 60m demo + introduce security & procurement
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Blake <tom@acmeops.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap — schedule a 60m demo + introduce security & procurement

Hi Tom — thanks for the time earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the follow-up demo: 

What we heard
- Primary use case: run near-real-time customer support summarization + on-prem data connectors.
- Success metric: sub-200ms token latency for 99th pct on a 2k context, and predictable monthly cost.

Next steps I suggest
1) 60-minute technical demo (platform walkthrough + SSO + perf expectations) — please include security and procurement.
2) Share a brief pre-demo checklist to confirm access and any restricted environments. (attached: pre-demo-checklist.xlsx)
3) If you can share the security contact and procurement email, I will loop them into scheduling and evidence requests.

Proposed demo windows (PST) — please pick one or suggest alternatives:
- Tue 17 Feb — 10:00 or 15:00
- Thu 19 Feb — 09:00 or 11:00

Marissa, Karthik — can you join the demo? Marissa will lead the walkthrough; Karthik can cover the platform/SSO details and procurement checklist.

Tom — once you confirm a slot and the security/procurement contacts I will send a calendar invite with the HubSpot meeting link and a short pre-demo questionnaire.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pre-demo-checklist.xlsx (xlsx)]
From: Tom Blake <tom@acmeops.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@acmeops.com>, procurement@acmeops.com
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 16:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — schedule a 60m demo + introduce security & procurement

Thanks, Irene — good summary.

We can do Thu 19 Feb at 11:00 PST. Alyssa Chen (cc'd) is our lead on security and will own the questionnaire/evidence intake. Procurement is the procurement@acmeops.com alias.

Two asks from our side before the demo:
- Can you share a short architecture diagram showing how Redwood would sit in front of our data connectors?
- Any blocker for us to do an internal threat-model review if Alyssa requests it?

If 19th at 11:00 works for your team, lock it and send the invite.

—Tom
Tom Blake | VP Product
AcmeOps
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Blake <tom@acmeops.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — schedule a 60m demo + introduce security & procurement

Great — Thu 19 Feb at 11:00 PST works for me. I can lead the demo and will allocate 45 minutes for platform/feature walkthrough and 15 minutes for security/procurement Q&A.

Tom — attaching a short SSO / onboarding primer we typically share (SSO_QuickStart.pdf). I'll also drop a brief tech questionnaire here to surface any constraints: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-example

A few notes:
- We support SAML-based SSO, SCIM provisioning, and can run dedicated VPC deployments for regulated environments.
- If Alyssa would like, we can pre-share a redacted topology diagram and SOC2 evidence pointers before the call.

Karthik — can you confirm platform-side availability for the 19th and if you want to prep any specific logs/evidence to show?

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SSO_QuickStart.pdf (pdf)]
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Blake <tom@acmeops.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — schedule a 60m demo + introduce security & procurement

Confirming I'll be on for Thu 19 Feb at 11:00 PST and will prepare a short section on:
- SSO flow (SAML), SCIM provisioning demo, and minimal config changes for on-prem connectors
- Expected observability/trace artifacts and where to find audit logs in Redwood Console
- Typical evidence bundle for procurement (SOC2 summary, data retention options, KMS integrations)

Irene — please use this HubSpot meeting link when you send the invite: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/67890

Tom — we'll also attach the architecture diagram to the invite. If Alyssa needs anything specific ahead of time (e.g., threat-model checklist), send it my way and we'll prioritize.

See you on the 19th,
Karthik

Redwood Inference
